mutations.name: a decode is never charged to the step's pixel budget
kills: measuring snapshot pairs under the step's fixed caps measures the first of three 64×64 pairs under a two-image budget, and neither reads nor decodes the others

mutations.name: an exhausted budget still reads the blobs
kills: measuring snapshot pairs under the step's fixed caps measures the first of three 64×64 pairs under a two-image budget, and neither reads nor decodes the others

mutations.name: a decode's pixel limit ignores the budget left
kills: measuring snapshot pairs under the step's fixed caps refuses a head larger than the budget left after its base, as over the step's budget

mutations.name: the blob read drops maxBytes
kills: measuring snapshot pairs under the step's fixed caps records a blob over maxBytes as unmeasured without the fake serving it

mutations.name: pairs over maxSnapshots are measured anyway
kills: measuring snapshot pairs under the step's fixed caps records every pair unmeasured with no blob or merge-base read when they number over maxSnapshots
